00499                         /* Make sure node i is not already in vids[0:dim] */
00500                         ck1 = 0;
00501                         for(j=0;j<mesh_in->dim+1;j++)
00502                                 if( vids[j] == i )
00503                         {
00504                                 ck1 = 1;
00505                                 break;
00506                         }
00507                         if( ck1 == 1 )
00508                                 continue; // i is already in the set, so continue
00509                         surf = mesh_vert_above_face_vert( mesh_in, mesh_in->vertx + i*mesh_in->dim, vids );
00510                         if( surf > 1.0 )
00511                         {
00512                                 for(k=0;k<mesh_in->dim;k++)
00513                                         wids[k] = vids[k];
00514                                 wids[mesh_in->dim] = i;
00515                                 m = 0;
00516                                 for(j=0;j<mesh_in->nvert;j++)
00517                                 {
00518                                         ck1 = 0;
00519                                         for(k=0;k<mesh_in->dim+1;k++)
00520                                                 if( wids[k] == j )
00521                                         {
00522                                                 ck1 = 1;
00523                                                 break;
00524                                         }
00525                                         if( ck1 == 1 )
00526                                                 continue;
00527                                         circ = mesh_vert_in_circsph_vert( mesh_in, mesh_in->vertx + j*mesh_in->dim, wids );
00528                                         if( circ < 0.0 )
00529                                         {
00530                                                 m = 1;
00531                                                 break;
00532                                         }
00533                                 }
00534                                 if( m == 0 ) // => no node in its circumsphere
00535                                 {
00536                                         /* Then the circumsphere is empty, so add to simplices */
00537                                         p = mesh_simpx_index( mesh_in, wids );
00538                                         if( p == -1 )
00539                                                 mesh_app_simpx( mesh_in, wids );
00540                                         else
00541                                                 continue;
00542 
00543                                         /* Now check the faces other than f */
00544                                         combinadic_init( mesh_in->dim + 1, mesh_in->dim, vec );
00545                                         for(j=0,k=mesh_in->dim-1;j<binomial(mesh_in->dim+1,mesh_in->dim)-1;j++,k--)
00546                                         {
00547                                                 combinadic_next( mesh_in->dim + 1, mesh_in->dim, vec );
00548                                                 for(m=0;m<mesh_in->dim;m++)
00549                                                         xids[m] = wids[vec[m]];
00550                                                 xids[mesh_in->dim] = wids[k];
00551 
00552                                                 /* Check xids against ufaces and add accordingly */
00553                                                 p = mesh_ufaces_index( mesh_in, xids );
00554                                                 if( p == -1 )
00555                                                         mesh_app_unf_face( mesh_in, xids );
00556                                                 else
00557                                                         mesh_del_unf_face( mesh_in, p );
00558                                         }
00559                                         break;
00560                                 }
00561                         }
00562                 }
00563         }
00564 
00565         return 0;
00566 }

00568 int list_init( list_t *list_in )
00569 {
00570         long int *tmp;
00571 
00572         list_in->start = NULL;
00573         list_in->pointer = NULL;
00574         list_in->size = 0;
00575         list_in->alloc = LIST_SIZE_INC;
00576         tmp = (long int*) realloc( list_in->pointer, LIST_SIZE_INC * sizeof(long int) );
00577         if( tmp == NULL )
00578                 return -1;
00579         list_in->pointer = tmp;
00580         list_in->start = list_in->pointer;
00581         return 0;
00582 }

00584 int list_free( list_t *list_in )
00585 {
00586         if( list_in->start != NULL )
00587                 free( list_in->pointer );
00588         else
00589                 return -1;
00590         return 0;

00593 int list_reset( list_t *list_in )
00594 {
00595         if( list_in->size < 0 )
00596                 return -1;
00597         memmove( list_in->pointer, list_in->start, list_in->size * sizeof(long int) );
00598         list_in->start = list_in->pointer;
00599         return 0;
00600 }

00602 int list_shift( list_t *list_in, int shift_in )
00603 {
00604         if( list_in->size <= 0
00605          || ( ( list_in->start + shift_in ) < list_in->pointer )
00606          || ( ( list_in->start + shift_in ) > ( list_in->pointer + list_in->size ) ) )
00607                 return -1; /* Meaning shift takes pointer out of range */
00608         if( shift_in == 0 )
00609                 return 0;
00610         list_in->start = (long int*) memmove( list_in->start + shift_in, list_in->start, list_in->size * sizeof(long int) );
00611         return 0;
00612 }

00623 int list_grow( list_t *list_in, int minc_in )
00624 {
00625         long int *tmp;
00626         list_reset( list_in );
00627         tmp = (long int*) realloc( list_in->pointer, ( list_in->alloc + minc_in ) * sizeof(long int) );
00628         if( tmp == NULL )
00629                 return -1;
00630         list_in->pointer = tmp;
00631         list_in->start = list_in->pointer;
00632         list_in->alloc += minc_in;
00633 
00634         return list_in->alloc;
00635 }

00637 int list_shrink( list_t *list_in, int mdec_in )
00638 {
00639         long int *tmp;
00640         list_reset( list_in ); /* Force list_in->start to coincide with list_in->pointer */
00641         tmp = (long int*) realloc( list_in->pointer, ( list_in->alloc - mdec_in ) * sizeof(long int) );
00642         if( tmp == NULL )
00643                 return -1;
00644         list_in->start = tmp;
00645         list_in->start = list_in->pointer;
00646         list_in->alloc -= mdec_in;
00647 
00648         return list_in->alloc;
00649 }

00651 int list_prepend( list_t *list_in, long int val_in )
00652 {
00653         if( list_in->size + 1 > list_in->alloc )
00654         {
00655                 if( list_grow( list_in, LIST_SIZE_INC ) == -1 )
00656                         return -1;
00657                 list_shift( list_in, 1 );
00658         }
00659         else
00660                 if( list_in->start <= list_in->pointer ) /* Meaning there is no memory allocated to the left, so make some */
00661                         list_shift( list_in, 1 );
00662 
00663         --list_in->start;
00664         list_in->start[0] = val_in;
00665         ++list_in->size;
00666 
00667         return list_in->size;
00668 }
00669 
00670 int list_append( list_t *list_in, long int val_in )
00671 {
00672         /* If there isn't enough memory allocated */
00673         if( list_in->size + 1 > list_in->alloc )
00674                 if( list_grow( list_in, LIST_SIZE_INC ) == -1 )
00675                         return -1;
00676         else /* If there is enough, then either there is some at the beginning or some at the end */
00677                 if( list_in->start > list_in->pointer ) /* If there is some at the beginning */
00678                         list_shift( list_in, 1 ); /* Shift to the right by sizeof(long) bytes */
00679 
00680         list_in->start[list_in->size] = val_in;
00681         ++list_in->size;
00682 
00683         return list_in->size;
00684 }

00686 long int list_popf( list_t *list_in )
00687 {
00688         long int out;
00689         if( list_in->size <= 0 )
00690                 return LIST_NULL_PTR;
00691         else
00692                 out = list_in->start[0];
00693         if( list_in->size > 1 )
00694                 ++list_in->start;
00695         --list_in->size;
00696         if( list_in->alloc - list_in->size >= LIST_SIZE_INC )
00697                 list_shrink( list_in, LIST_SIZE_INC );
00698         return out;
00699 }

00704 
00705         if( list_in->size <= 0 )
00706                 return LIST_NULL_PTR;

00708                 out = list_in->start[list_in->size-1];

00711                 list_shrink( list_in, LIST_SIZE_INC );
